segments.title: Apple Maps has trending lists
segments.say: Apple Maps now has lists of what's trending near you. Most people never find them.

segments.title: It's called Local Lists
segments.say: It's called Local Lists, and it's new in iOS twenty-seven.

segments.title: Swipe up, find Guides
segments.say: Open Maps, swipe up on the bottom card, and tap a list in the Guides section.

segments.title: Breakfast, parks, museums
segments.sub: Each list shows **when it was updated**
segments.say: Breakfast spots. Parks. Museums. Each list shows when it was last updated.

segments.title: US cities only, for now
segments.sub: Not every area · **Not tested by us**
segments.say: It's US cities only for now, and not every area has lists. Not tested by us.
